newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse closes easier in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse closes easier in moderate trade.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index shed 0.83 points to close at 3461.59 in a moderate trading session on Monday, brokers and bourse officials said.
Turnover was 16.6 million shillings ($26,700) traded on 522,606 shares compared to 89.8 million shillings on 1,218,943 shares on Friday.
Rea Vipingo Plantations traded at 9.05 from 9.10 while George Williamson Kenya edged a shilling to close at 71 from 70.
Kenya Airways traded at a reserve price of 8.50 on the three-day special board while Uchumi Supermarket eased by a shilling to close at 38.
Barclays Bank was unchanged at 110 while National Bank of Kenya closed at 15.70 from 15.30.
Foreign investors bought Kenya Commercial Bank at between 105 and 107 compared to 105, National Industrial Credit Bank at 57 unchanged and Firestone East Africa at 28.75 from 33.
Kenya Breweries edged a shilling to close at 58 while Kenya Power & Lighting eased to 175 from 177.
